memories.text: Appointment booked for initial consultation with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) on 2025-04-05 at 10:00 AM. Reason: evaluation of fatigue and pallor.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Hb 9.2 g/dL (ref 13.0-17.0), ferritin 12 ng/mL (ref 30-300), MCV 72 fL (ref 80-100). Weight 68 kg, waist 82 cm (male cutoff 90 cm). Fatigue moderate, pallor noted.
  - Plan: Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food. Advise iron-rich diet (lunch: dal, leafy veg; dinner: meat, vitamin C). Review in 3 months.
- Due: HbA1c not indicated (no glucose-lowering therapy).
